title: AIIMS Jodhpur Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 04 Research Scientist I, Research Assistant and Laboratory Technician Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 04 Research Scientist I, Research Assistant, and Laboratory Technician positions. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS, BDS, Post Graduation, or B.Sc can grab this chance and apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur Notification 2026 .
